namejet.deposit_required: None — credit card on file required

prebid_system.description: NameJet uses a pre-bid/backorder system where your backorder amount IS your starting bid — it is NOT a proxy bid
how_it_works: Enter the exact amount you're willing to pay as your backorder amount
This amount becomes your STARTING BID in any auction — not a maximum
If you're the only backorder holder, you win at your bid amount (minimum $69)
If multiple backorder holders exist, a 3-day private auction begins
During the auction, you can increase your maximum bid
Proxy bidding is used during the auction phase (auto-increments up to your max)
prebid_system.critical_warning: Your backorder amount is NOT a proxy bid — it's the literal amount you'll pay if you're the only bidder. Set it to $69 (minimum) unless you want to start higher.

expired_domain_timeline: Day 1-25: Grace period (registrant can still renew)
Day 26-36: Domain listed as Expired Domain on GoDaddy Auctions (10-day auction)
Day 30-36: Current registrant CANNOT manually renew if there's an active bid
Day 37-42: Final Closeout auction (5 days) if no winner
Day 43: All auctions end — winner gets domain or domain releases to registry
